title: Vegetable Rice Salad
description: Vegetable Rice Salad is a light and refreshing Continental salad made with fluffy long-grain rice, colorful vegetables, and a tangy Dijon vinaigrette. Perfect as a healthy appetizer, side dish, or light meal.

ingredients.title: For the Rice Base
items: Long-grain rice (preferably Basmati or Jasmine) – 200 g (1 cup)

ingredients.title: Fresh Vegetables
items: Red bell pepper – ½ cup, diced
Yellow bell pepper – ½ cup, diced
Green beans – ½ cup, cut into small pieces and blanched
Carrot – ½ cup, diced and blanched

ingredients.title: For the Dressing
items: White wine vinegar – 2 tbsp (or lemon juice)
Black pepper – freshly ground, to taste

ingredients.title: For Garnish
items: Toasted pine nuts or almonds – 2 tbsp

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Rice
steps: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear.
Cook in vegetable stock with olive oil and salt until fluffy (12–15 minutes).
Spread the cooked rice on a tray and allow it to cool completely.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Vegetables
steps: Dice the bell peppers, cucumber, and cherry tomatoes.
Blanch the carrots, green beans, and peas until just tender.
Transfer immediately to ice water, then drain well.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Prepare the Dressing
steps: Whisk together olive oil, white wine vinegar (or lemon juice), Dijon mustard, honey, garlic, salt, and black pepper until well emulsified.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Assemble the Salad
steps: Combine the cooled rice and prepared vegetables in a large bowl.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently until evenly coated.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Finishing Touches
steps: Arrange the salad neatly on a serving plate using a ring mold if desired.
Garnish with toasted pine nuts or almonds and fresh herbs.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled as a light appetizer or side dish.
Pair with grilled chicken, fish, or roasted vegetables.
Enjoy with chilled white wine for a complete continental meal.

chefTips: Cool the rice completely before mixing to prevent a sticky salad.
Blanch vegetables briefly to retain their color and crunch.
Add crumbled feta cheese or grilled zucchini for extra flavor.
Toss the salad gently to keep the vegetables intact.
